shorts_extract.hook: Knowing every rule of chess without remembering a single game — or picturing tomorrow: how Endel Tulving and Patient K.C. discovered Mental Time Travel.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Tulving (1972/2002 Annu. Rev. Psychol.) Semantic vs Episodic split in Patient K.C. + 2007 Science Past–Future hippocampal simulation proof.
shorts_extract.twist: Why children without hippocampi still pass school geography (Vargha-Khadem 1997), why memory is constructive so we can simulate tomorrow, and Demis Hassabis's AI link.
